network_status.network: Analisi dell'evento meteorologico del 27-29 novembre 2020 in Sardegna
network_status.summary_it: Il rapporto ufficiale ricostruisce l'evento di Bitti e pubblica le precipitazioni locali, mentre l'analisi idrologica strumentale riguarda il bacino del Posada e la diga di Maccheronis. Non è pubblicato un livello o una portata del Rio de Malò: i dati del Posada non vengono trasferiti al ponte e la pioggia non viene convertita in idrometria.
network_status.summary_en: The official report reconstructs the Bitti event and publishes local rainfall, while its instrumented hydrological analysis concerns the Posada basin and Maccheronis dam. It provides no Rio de Malò stage or discharge, so Posada data are not transferred to the bridge and rainfall is not converted into hydrometry.

provenance.method: Manual extraction encoded in the ARCUS event-report curation registry

caveats: The cited source review is complete; no compatible tabulated bridge-section value is assigned.
ARCUS does not digitise plotted hydrographs into false-precision event peaks.
The encoded failure process remains separate from hydrometric evidence.
Rainfall is not converted into stage or discharge.
